snippets.roadside: small, about the size of one of the riders, at the roadside where the road starts to climb

coins.name: Berlin
coins.scene: Main motif: the Berlin TV tower (Fernsehturm), tall and slim with its ball and antenna, its tip staying below the arc line. Support: the Brandenburg Gate with its columns and the quadriga on top, smaller, at the left. Ground: the river Spree running along the bottom, a few calm wave lines. Dry touch: the East German traffic-light man (Ampelmännchen, the little walking man with his hat) walking along the road beside the riders, {{roadside}}.

coins.name: München
coins.scene: Main motif: the Frauenkirche in Munich, its two tall towers with their round onion-shaped domes, big, in the left half. Support: next to the church and about as tall as its nave, a big Bavarian pretzel (Brezn) standing upright beside a big one-litre beer mug (Maßkrug) with a foam head, together as one group. The Bavarian blue-and-white: a long ribbon with the Bavarian diamond (lozenge) pattern, drawn as a grid of diagonal diamonds, waving across the scene in front of the church's base. Ground: a meadow. Nothing else: no maypole.

coins.name: Black Forest
coins.scene: One calm valley view, everything belonging together. Behind: two soft rounded hills, completely covered with dark fir forest, drawn as rows of simple pointed fir silhouettes, the hilltops well below the arc line. Main motif: in the middle, in front of the hills, one Black Forest farmhouse sitting on a sloping meadow, big: a huge hipped roof that comes down on both sides almost to the ground and takes up two thirds of the house's height, a small hipped half-gable at the front, under it two short rows of small windows and a wooden balcony running along the front. Support: in the left foreground, on top of a post of a short wooden fence that runs along the meadow, hangs a Bollenhut, the traditional Black Forest hat, big and clearly readable: a flat round hat with a wide brim, seen slightly from above, its top covered with fourteen big round woollen pompoms set close together in a cross shape; it is the only hat and nobody wears it. Ground: the meadow slopes gently down to the road, a few short grass tufts. Dry touch: a slice of Black Forest cherry cake, layered, with a swirl of cream and one cherry on top, on a small plate on a little wooden table at the roadside, {{roadside}}. Nothing else: no extra trees in the foreground, no bushes, no cuckoo clock, no animals.

coins.name: RheinRuhr
coins.scene: Main motif: the double headframe of the Zollverein coal mine (Schacht XII), the steel winding tower with its two big wheels on top. Support: a gasometer, the tall round industrial gas holder, at the left. Ground: flat industrial land. Dry touch: the climb is a spoil heap (a mining slag heap), not a mountain; a small signpost on it reads "GLÜCK AUF", {{roadside}}.

coins.name: Niederrhein
coins.scene: Main motif: a Lower Rhine windmill, a tall tower mill with four sails. Support: a row of pollarded willows (Kopfweiden), short thick trunks with bushy heads of thin branches. Ground: completely flat land with a dyke along the river Rhine. Dry touch: everything is dead flat all the way, the road a dead straight line, until the climb starts abruptly and steeply right before Paris.

coins.name: Nieder-Olm
coins.scene: Main motif: a small round vineyard hut (Weinbergshäuschen, a little round stone hut with a cone roof) among rolling hills covered with rows of vines. Support: a big glass of wine on a stem. Ground: gentle rolling vineyard hills. Dry touch: the lead rider wears a carnival jester's cap (Narrenkappe) over the helmet.

coins.name: Frankfurt
coins.scene: Main motif: the Frankfurt skyline, a group of skyscrapers including the Messeturm with its pyramid top, the tallest staying below the arc line. Support: the stepped gables of the Römer, the old half-timbered town hall facades, in front of the skyline at the left. Ground: the river Main along the bottom, a few calm wave lines. Dry touch: an apple-wine jug (Bembel, a grey stoneware jug) with a ribbed glass (Geripptes) next to it at the roadside, {{roadside}}.

coins.name: Flensburg
coins.scene: Main motif: an old sailing ship with two masts and furled sails in the harbour of the Flensburg fjord (Förde). Support: a lighthouse at the left. Ground: the fjord's water along the bottom, a few calm wave lines. Dry touch: a wooden rum barrel at the roadside with a swing-top beer bottle on it, its stopper just popping open with a few short lines, {{roadside}}.

coins.name: Mecklenburg
coins.scene: Main motif: Schwerin Castle on its island in the lake, the fairy-tale palace with its many towers, turrets and golden dome. Support: a wicker beach chair (Strandkorb) on a bit of beach at the left. Ground: the lake along the bottom, a few calm wave lines. Dry touch: three cranes (the birds, long necks and legs stretched out) flying over the lake in a loose row.

coins.name: 100 Germany
coins.scene: Main motif: the outline of Germany as a simple map shape, with a road running out of it towards the climb and Paris. Support: a small kilometre stone at the start of the road reading "100". Ground: a gentle meadow. Dry touch: a cup of coffee and a croissant on a small café table at the roadside, {{roadside}}.
